entries.reason: No discoverable official website exists for Urgench State Medical Institute, formed in April 2025 from the former Urgench branch of Tashkent Medical Academy. Confirmed no Wikipedia article exists (direct fetch attempt returns 404). Probed several plausible domain-name guesses; the only one that resolves, urganch-med.uz, is a different institution entirely ('Urganch Abu Ali ibn Sino nomidagi Jamoat salomatligi texnikumi' - a Public Health Technicum/college, not this medical institute) and must not be used or merged. This is an identity/status gap tied to the institution's recent formation and rename, not a media-sourcing gap; no logo or cover is nominated.
